data.body: AC amendment: DD-1 live verification — After implementing verify-aws-account.sh, run it once against the live AWS environment: bash plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh. Capture stdout/stderr and exit code. Assert exit code == 0 and confirm account 820258254566 in output. Record command + exit code + trimmed output in completion notes as DD-1 evidence. AWS CLI is confirmed present and aws sts get-caller-identity returns Account=820258254566.
